point_sensitivities.note: point sensitivities of two SEPARATELY fitted posteriors; no posterior interval for the between-treatment difference is estimated (that would require a declared joint analysis over both currency treatments -- pairing separately fitted chains by seed or draw index is not a joint posterior). Each fit's own parameter HDIs, diagnostics and conditional summaries are under fits/<label>

V1_VaR995.operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero

point_sensitivities.overlay_sensitivity_note: no overlay leg: both refits fix gamma at 0 in the likelihood, as the headline does since option B (10 October 2026), so they have no fitted concentration exponent for an overlay to apply; the overlay is reported on the full-sample gamma-free fit only

conditional_fit_summaries.note: conditional summaries within the adopted specification. P_nu_ritc_lt_nu_clean is this fit's own-posterior tail-regime ordering; floor_hdi95 and k_hdi95 are conditional parameter summaries only -- the floor-versus-no-floor and pooling-endpoint model comparisons were NOT repeated under this treatment, and the bracketed fit cannot re-establish them
